rear_impact.supplierSource: Supply events in the 300000 blocks before the fork block, ranked by Comet balance at the fork block
rear_impact.note: Suppliers are the three largest holders found from Supply events in the 2000000 blocks before the fork block, ranked by Comet balance at that block.

pole_test.upgradePath: governor proposal, then timelock delay, then CometProxyAdmin.upgrade

thresholds.status: declared before execution, pending Test Director sign-off

rear_impact.held: at least 95 percent of the requested withdrawal leaves the market
rear_impact.degraded: at least 50 percent and below 95 percent

pole_test.held: withdrawals can be paused, user funds cannot be moved by one key without a delay above zero
pole_test.degraded: a privileged key can move funds but only after a delay
pole_test.failed: a privileged key can move funds with no delay
